parts.title: General Issues in Organizational Psychology in Business

questions.q: An employee receives contradictory instructions from two different managers about the same task. Which concept does this describe?
A team is very close and loyal, but its shared norm is to work slowly and not exceed a "fair" output. What is the most likely effect of this cohesion?
options: It improves performance because members support each other
It has no effect on performance
It lowers performance because the group's standard is negative
It automatically turns the team into a formal group

questions.q: Which example best shows task cohesion (commitment to the task)?
options: Colleagues who enjoy sharing lunch breaks together
Staff who are proud of their department's reputation
Employees who are friends outside of work
A project team that is determined to deliver the project well

questions.q: According to the punctuated equilibrium model, when do teams typically make a major change in how they work?
options: At the midpoint between the first meeting and the deadline
Only after the conflict (storming) stage ends

questions.q: Which statement about psychological safety is correct?
options: It is the same thing as team cohesion
A close team can still lack psychological safety if members avoid disagreement
It means team members never experience conflict
It only depends on employees' personality traits

questions.q: In Schein's model of culture, stories, rituals and ceremonies belong to which level?
What is the main difference between tradition and psychological climate?
options: Tradition is relatively stable, while psychological climate is flexible and changes easily
Tradition is short-term, while psychological climate lasts for generations
Tradition belongs to individuals, while climate belongs to firms
There is no difference between them

questions.q: Two team members argue over who should take on a duty and how to divide the budget. What type of conflict is this?
A manager ignores a dispute between two employees, hoping it will disappear on its own. According to dual concern theory, which conflict style is this?
Which statement correctly links the five phenomena?
options: A healthy psychological climate speeds the spread of positive mood
Competition has no connection to conflict or culture
Emotional contagion only happens in toxic climates
Tradition and conflict are unrelated to climate

parts.title: Psychological Theories for Enhancing Employee Motivation

questions.q: Which of the following is a motivator (not a hygiene factor) in Herzberg's two-factor theory?
An employee believes that working harder will not improve their performance. Which component of Vroom's expectancy theory is low?
An employee wants to build close, friendly relationships with colleagues. Which of McClelland's three needs does this show?
According to equity theory, which of the following is NOT a way an employee may react to perceived inequity?
options: Changing their own inputs or outcomes
Distorting their perception of inputs or outcomes
Setting a more difficult personal goal
